notes: A large file that barely changed now travels as only the 1MB blocks that differ from the copy already installed. Measured: NovaPanel.exe is 168.7MB and FOUR BYTES of it change per release (the stamped version), so the update that carried…

Every rebuilt file is checked twice: the installed copy must match the hash the delta was built against, and the result must match the release's own sha256, so what lands is byte-identical to a full install. A mismatch fails the update…

A patch only uses what the installed version can apply: whole-file patches from 1.1.717 (the first build that understands them) and block deltas from 1.1.718, because the client that applies a patch is the old one.
Update archives are cached with a bound again -- patches are pruned alongside full artifacts rather than accumulating unnoticed.
